business_overview.one_sentence: Lion Rock Group is an investment holding company operating printing services and publishing services for global book trade customers.

segments.name: Printing
segments.source: Annual Report 2023 Note 6 segment information, pp. 74-75

segments.name: Publishing
segments.source: Annual Report 2023 Note 6 segment information, pp. 74-75

business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue from printing income and publishing income; publishing includes title development and rights/book sales, while printing serves publishers and book-trade customers.
business_notes: 2023 revenue increased 2.7% mainly because Quarto contributed a full year versus nine months in 2022.
Management said the Group reviewed cash/debt levels and repaid bank debt because no attractive M&A opportunities were found.
